blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Supreme Court has relaxed the rules in proving whether a divorce between a Filipino and a foreigner took place in another country where it is legal. The high court initiated amendments to Sec. 48 of Rule 39 of the Rules of Court, specifically on the effect of judgments or orders under foreign laws, in an en banc session on Wednesday.
